messages:
Liam: FYI Aurora partner ran a promo calc bug during onboarding; partner-level customers were undercharged and Aurora is asking Redwood to cover a goodwill adjustment so they can credit merchants.
Yara: Can you paste the sample lines and total exposure?
Liam: They attached CSV snippet. Quick sum = $9,150 across 21 merchants after proration. Sample: `invoice_id,merchant,period,charged,should_have,delta\ninv-9922,GreenHarbor,2025-03,$450,$900,$450`
Carlos: Ops question  do we issue a consolidated partner credit memo or pay Aurora and let them reimburse merchants? Partner agreement allows either; they requested a consolidated credit memo to speed reconciliation.
Grace: Finance lead here  approved consolidated credit memo to Aurora for $9,150. GL code: `GL-MISC-GOODWILL-2025`. Memo: "Aurora onboarding promo goodwill adjustment Mar 2025".
payments-bot: Created ticket PAY-1173 for payment ops. Owner: Carlos.
finance-bot: Created FIN-5099 record for manual credit memo workflow. Status: awaiting attachments and partner ack. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-5099
Yara: CFO noted via DM: amount < $10k so finance lead approval ok but request a one-line disclosure in month close.
Carlos: Ops preference: post credit memo (CM) and include partner ref they requested: `AUR-ONB-2025-03`. Posting date planned 2025-04-02 EOD to match accruals.
Liam: Also request Aurora sign a one-page allocation ack confirming they'll apply the credit to impacted merchants. I'll ask for that now.
Aurora (via Liam): Provided signed ack PDF and asked that memo include ref `AUR-ONB-2025-03`.
finance-bot: FIN-5099 updated: attachments received (CSV sample, Aurora ack). Status: ready for posting.
tax-team: Quick note: partner rebates may have VAT implications depending on pass-through. Please attach the CSV before final posting; we'll append a tax memo.
Grace: Tax attached guidance pending review but okay to proceed with posting once memo included.
Carlos: Drafted credit memo. CM ref: CM-2025-2319. Posting now.
payments-bot: Credit memo posted: CM-2025-2319, posted 2025-04-02, amount $9,150. Ledger GL `GL-MISC-GOODWILL-2025`.
Liam: Confirmed update to the Q1 reconciliation workbook and month-end note: "Goodwill partner credit to Aurora for onboarding promo miscalc, $9,150."
Grace: Thanks. Closing FIN-5099 and adding the one-line note to close pack.
finance-bot: FIN-5099 closed by Grace."
